name: PET
description: PET 核心词汇，覆盖日常场景高频词。

words.chinese: 能力，能够；才能，技能，本领
words.definition: The skill or power to do something.
examples: She has the ability to solve problems quickly.

words.chinese: 能够，有能力的；聪明能干的，精通（某事）的
words.definition: Having the skill, power, or means to do something.
examples: He is able to swim very well.

words.chinese: 大约；几乎；到处，各处
words.definition: (adverb) Almost; (preposition) on the subject of.
examples: The movie is about a hero.

words.chinese: （数量或度量）在……以上，超过；在（或向）……上面；（级别或地位上）高于
words.definition: Higher than something else; more than a number or level.
examples: The picture hangs above the sofa.

words.chinese: 在国外，到国外；<旧>在室外，到室外；<正式> 广为流传，广为人知
words.definition: In or to a foreign country or countries.
examples: She studied abroad last year.

words.chinese: 缺勤的，缺席的；不存在的，缺乏的；心不在焉的，出神的
words.definition: Not present in a place or event.
examples: He was absent from school yesterday.

words.chinese: 绝对地，完全地；确实地，极其；（强调同意或允许）当然，对极了
words.definition: Completely or totally.
examples: I absolutely agree with you.

words.chinese: 口音，腔调，土音；着重点，强调；重音
words.definition: The way someone pronounces words, showing their origin.
examples: He has a strong French accent.

words.chinese: 接受，收受；同意，赞成；相信，认为……正确
words.definition: To agree to receive or do something.
examples: She accepted the job offer.

words.chinese: 可接受的，（大多数人）认同的；合意的，令人满意的；尚可的，勉强的
words.definition: Good enough or allowed.
examples: Your behaviour is not acceptable.

words.chinese: 入口，通道；获得的机会，使用权；（对计算机存储器的）访问，存取
words.definition: The right or opportunity to use or see something.
examples: Students have access to the library.

words.chinese: 交通事故，车祸；（不幸的）意外遭遇，不测事件；意外，偶然的事
words.definition: An unexpected event causing damage or injury.
examples: He broke his leg in a car accident.

words.chinese: <美>住宿，膳宿；<英>住处，办公处，停留处；（楼房或交通工具内的）空间，座位
words.definition: A place to live or stay, especially when travelling.
examples: We booked accommodation near the beach.

words.chinese: 陪伴，陪同；伴随，与……一起发生；为……伴奏（或伴唱）
words.definition: To go somewhere with someone.
examples: I will accompany you to the doctor.

words.chinese: 根据：表示根据某人或某事的陈述、说法或信念；按照：表示按照某个标准、规则或方法；据……所述：表示根据某人的陈述或说法
words.definition: As stated or reported by someone or something.
examples: According to the weather forecast, it will rain tomorrow.

words.chinese: 账户，户头；客户，老主顾；网络账号
words.definition: A record or statement of money received and spent.
examples: I opened a bank account last week.

words.chinese: 会计，会计师
words.definition: A person who keeps or inspects financial accounts.
examples: The accountant prepared the company's tax report.

words.chinese: 准确的，精确的；（工具，方法）精密的；正确无误的
words.definition: Correct and without mistakes or errors.
examples: The map is accurate and easy to read.

words.chinese: （隐隐地、持续地）疼痛；渴望；哀痛，怜悯
words.definition: A continuous, dull pain in a part of the body.
examples: I have a headache after working all day.

words.chinese: （经努力）达到，取得，实现；获得成功
words.definition: To successfully complete or reach a goal.
examples: He worked hard to achieve his dream.

words.chinese: 成绩，成就；完成，实现；（纹章）纹章牌
words.definition: Something done successfully, especially by effort.
examples: Graduating from university was a great achievement.

words.chinese: 从一边到另一边；在……对面；朝，向
words.definition: (adv) From one side to the other; (prep) on the other side of something.
examples: She ran across the street quickly.

words.chinese: 行动；举动，表现；假装
words.definition: (v) To do something; (n) a part of a play or law.
examples: He acted in a school play last year.

words.chinese: 行动；行为；战斗
words.definition: The process of doing something to achieve a result.
examples: Taking action quickly can solve problems.

words.chinese: 好动的；积极主动的；定期进行的，起作用的
words.definition: Engaging in physical movement or activity.
examples: She is very active and likes sports.

words.chinese: 活跃状况，热闹；活动；（Activity）热力活性，活度
words.definition: Something that people do for enjoyment or work.
examples: Swimming is a popular activity in summer.

words.chinese: 演员；像在演戏的人；（行动或过程）参与者
words.definition: A person who performs in plays, movies, or TV shows.
examples: He is a famous actor in many films.

words.chinese: 女演员
words.definition: A female actor who performs in plays, movies, or TV shows.
examples: The actress won an award for her role.

words.chinese: 实际上，事实上；（用于开始新话题）其实；竟然，居然
words.definition: Used to show the true or real situation.
examples: Actually, I don’t like coffee.

words.chinese: 添加，掺入；（使）相加，加；增加
words.definition: To put something with something else to increase the amount or number.
examples: Please add sugar to the tea.

words.chinese: 增加物，新增人员；增加；加法
words.definition: The process of putting two or more things together to increase the total.
examples: The addition of new students made the class bigger.

words.chinese: 地址，住址；网址；电子邮箱地址
words.definition: The details of where someone lives or works.
examples: Write your address on the form.

words.chinese: 钦佩，仰慕；欣赏，观赏
words.definition: To respect or like someone or something very much.
examples: I admire her for working so hard.

words.chinese: 承认，供认；允许进入（加入），进入权；录取，录取人数
words.definition: The act of allowing someone to enter a place or event.
examples: Admission to the museum costs five pounds.

words.chinese: （勉强）承认；招认，招供；准许进入（某处）
words.definition: To agree that something is true, often unwillingly.
examples: She admitted her mistake.

words.chinese: 成年人或动物；成年的，发育成熟的；成人的，理智的
words.definition: (adj.) Fully grown or developed; (n.) A person who is fully grown.
examples: Only adults can enter this club.

words.chinese: （使）前进，（使）向前移动；发展，进步；预付
words.definition: Progress or improvement in a particular area.
examples: There has been an advance in technology.

words.chinese: 先进的；高级的，高等的；晚期的，状况不佳的
words.definition: At a higher or more difficult level than usual.
examples: She is taking an advanced English course.

words.chinese: 有利条件，优势；优点；利益
words.definition: A condition that helps someone be better or more successful.
examples: Having a car is an advantage in the city.

words.chinese: 冒险（经历），奇遇；冒险的刺激，冒险欲；<古>生意
words.definition: An exciting or unusual experience or activity.
examples: They went on an adventure in the forest.

words.chinese: <英>广告；提及
words.definition: A short form of advertisement, a message promoting something.
examples: I saw an advert for a new movie.

words.chinese: 为……做广告，登广告；公布，征聘；宣扬
words.definition: To tell the public about a product or event to sell or promote it.
examples: They advertise their products on TV.

words.chinese: 广告；（某一类事物的）活广告；广告活动，广告宣传
words.definition: A public message that promotes a product, service, or event.
examples: The advertisement was very colourful.

words.chinese: 忠告，劝告，建议；（金融交易）正式通知；消息
words.definition: A suggestion or recommendation about what someone should do.
examples: She gave me good advice about studying.

words.chinese: 通知，告知；劝告，建议
words.definition: To give someone advice or information about what they should do.
examples: I advise you to take an umbrella.

words.chinese: <英> 飞机
words.definition: A vehicle that flies in the air with wings and an engine.
examples: We travelled to London by aeroplane.

words.chinese: 影响；（疾病）侵袭，感染；（在感情上）深深打动，震撼
words.definition: To produce a change or influence something.
examples: The weather can affect your mood.

words.chinese: 买得起；有（时间）做某事；承担得起
words.definition: To have enough money to buy or do something.
examples: I can't afford a new car right now.

words.chinese: 害怕的；担心的；（害怕后果而）不愿意的，勉强的
words.definition: Feeling fear or worry about something.
examples: She is afraid of spiders.

words.chinese: 在……之后；紧接着；一次接着一次，持续不断地
words.definition: (adv., conj., prep.) Used to show time or order after something else.
examples: We went home after the movie.

words.chinese: 午后，下午；<非正式>下午好（问候用语）
words.definition: The part of the day from noon until evening.
examples: We will meet in the afternoon.

words.chinese: 过后，后来
words.definition: At a later time; after something else has happened.
examples: We had dinner and went to the cinema afterwards.

words.chinese: 再一次；复原；<非正式>请再说一遍
words.definition: One more time; once more.
examples: Please say that again.

words.chinese: 反对；（行为）违背……；（法律或法规）禁止
words.definition: In opposition to; touching or leaning on something.
examples: The chair is against the wall.

words.chinese: 年龄，年纪；寿命，（物的）年代；法定年龄
words.definition: The length of time that a person or thing has lived or existed.
examples: What is your age?

words.chinese: ……岁的；年老的，年迈的；老化的
words.definition: Having a particular age, often used to describe older people.
examples: He is an aged man of 80.

words.chinese: 代理行，经销处；政府专门机构，政府内的局，部，处；（尤指产生某效果的）作用
words.definition: A business or organization that provides a particular service.
examples: She works for a travel agency.

words.chinese: 时代，长时间
words.definition: Long periods of time in history or a person's life.
examples: Dinosaurs lived millions of ages ago.

words.chinese: 以前，从前；以前的
words.definition: Used to show how much time has passed before now.
examples: I met her two years ago.

words.chinese: 同意，赞成；答应，接受；达成一致意见
words.definition: To have the same opinion or accept a suggestion or idea.
examples: We agree on the plan.

words.chinese: 在前面，朝前面；领先，占优势；提前，预先
words.definition: In front or further forward in space or time.
examples: The car ahead stopped suddenly.

words.chinese: 目标，目的；瞄准，对准；枪法，击中目标的能力
words.definition: A goal or purpose that you want to achieve.
examples: Her aim is to become a doctor.

words.chinese: 大气，空气；空中，天空；乘坐飞机，航空
words.definition: The invisible mixture of gases we breathe around us.
examples: The air is fresh in the countryside.

words.chinese: 空调系统（=<英>air-conditioning）
words.definition: A system that cools and cleans the air inside a building or vehicle.
examples: The office has air conditioning.

words.chinese: 空军：一支主要从事空战的军事部队，与陆军和海军相对
words.definition: The part of a country's military that uses aircraft.
examples: He joined the air force last year.

words.chinese: 航空公司；输气管（air line）；航线
words.definition: A company that flies planes to carry passengers or goods.
examples: I booked a ticket with a cheap airline.

words.chinese: 机场，航空站 （港）；空旅通俗读物
words.definition: A place where planes take off and land.
examples: We arrived at the airport early.

words.chinese: 警报；警报器；闹钟
words.definition: A device or signal that warns of danger or a problem.
examples: The fire alarm went off.

words.chinese: 闹钟：一种可以设定在特定时间响铃（尤指用于叫醒人）的钟表
words.definition: A clock that makes a sound to wake someone up at a set time.
examples: I set my alarm clock for 7 a.m.

words.chinese: 唱片，专辑；相册，影集，集邮册
words.definition: A collection of songs or pictures in one book or record.
examples: She bought a new music album.

words.chinese: 相似的，相像的；相似地，相同地；两者都，同样地
words.definition: In a similar way or manner.
examples: The twins dress alike.

words.chinese: 活着的；仍然存在的；活跃的，充满活力的
words.definition: Living, not dead.
examples: The plant is still alive.

words.chinese: 全部；每一个；极度，尽量
words.definition: Used to refer to the whole amount or every one of something.
examples: All the students passed the test.

words.chinese: 允许，准许；使有可能；任凭
words.definition: To give permission for someone to do something or for something to happen.
examples: My parents allow me to stay out late.

words.chinese: 几乎，差不多
words.definition: Nearly, but not completely or exactly.
examples: I almost finished my homework.

words.chinese: 独自的；单独的；孤独的，无依无靠的
words.definition: Without other people; by oneself.
examples: She lives alone in a small house.

words.chinese: 沿着，顺着；靠着……边；在某处
words.definition: Moving in a constant direction on or beside something; from one end to the other.
examples: We walked along the river.

words.chinese: 大声地，出声地
words.definition: In a voice loud enough to be heard clearly.
examples: Please read the story aloud.

words.chinese: 字母表；基本要素；初步，入门
words.definition: A set of letters or symbols in a fixed order used for writing a language.
examples: The English alphabet has 26 letters.

words.chinese: 已经，早已；<美，非正式>马上，够了（用于表达不耐烦或气恼）
words.definition: Before now or before a particular time; previously.
examples: I have already eaten lunch.

words.chinese: 此外，而且；也，同样；另外，又
words.definition: In addition; too; also.
examples: I like coffee, and I also like tea.

words.chinese: 虽然，尽管；但是，然而
words.definition: Used to introduce a fact that makes the main statement surprising or unexpected.
examples: Although it was raining, we went out.

words.chinese: 完全地；总共；总之
words.definition: Completely; in total.
examples: There were ten people altogether.

words.chinese: 总是，每次都是；一直，长久以来；永远
words.definition: At all times; on every occasion.
examples: She always arrives early.

words.chinese: 惊奇的，惊讶的；使惊奇，使惊愕（amaze 的过去式和过去分词形式）
words.definition: Very surprised or impressed by something.
examples: I was amazed by the magic show.

words.chinese: 惊人的，了不起的；令人诧异的，令人惊愕的；令人高兴的
words.definition: Causing great surprise or wonder; very impressive.
examples: The view from the mountain was amazing.

words.chinese: 追求的目标，抱负；雄心，野心；干劲
words.definition: A strong desire to achieve something, usually requiring effort and determination.
examples: Her ambition is to become a doctor.

words.chinese: 急救车，救护车；用救护车送（人）
words.definition: A vehicle equipped for taking sick or injured people to hospital.
examples: The ambulance arrived quickly after the accident.

words.chinese: 数量，量；金额，钱数；（感情、质量的）程度
words.definition: A quantity of something, especially the total of money or things.
examples: The amount of sugar in this recipe is too much.

words.chinese: 逗人发笑的，有趣的；逗乐，逗笑；（提供）消遣（amuse 的现在分词形式）
words.definition: Causing laughter or enjoyment; funny.
examples: The movie was very amusing and made us laugh.

words.chinese: 一个（用于元音前）；一（在元音音素前）
words.definition: Used before words beginning with a vowel sound to refer to one person or thing.
examples: I saw an elephant at the zoo.

words.chinese: 古代的，远古的；古老的，年代久远的；老的，老掉牙的
words.definition: Very old; belonging to a period long ago in history.
examples: They visited ancient ruins in Greece.

words.chinese: （用于并列连接）和，与，及；（表示结果）于是，就；（表示先后）然后，接着
words.definition: Used to connect words or parts of a sentence that are joined together.
examples: I like tea and coffee.

words.chinese: 愤怒的，生气的；狂风暴雨的，波涛汹涌的；红肿的，感染的
words.definition: Feeling or showing strong displeasure or annoyance.
examples: He was angry because he lost his keys.

words.chinese: 动物；兽类；<非正式>衣冠禽兽，畜牲
words.definition: A living creature that is not a human, bird, fish, or insect.
examples: The zoo has many different animals.

words.chinese: 脚踝，踝关节；<美，非正式>走；离开
words.definition: The joint connecting the foot with the leg.
examples: She twisted her ankle while running.

words.chinese: 周年纪念（日）
words.definition: The date on which an event happened in a previous year.
examples: They celebrated their wedding anniversary.

words.chinese: 宣布，公布；声称，郑重地说；（尤指通过广播）通知
words.definition: To make something known publicly or officially.
examples: The school will announce the exam results tomorrow.

words.chinese: 公告；（报纸上的）布告；宣布
words.definition: A public or official statement about something.
examples: The announcement about the new rules was clear.

words.chinese: 使恼怒，使烦恼；打扰，骚扰；<古>侵扰
words.definition: To make someone slightly angry or upset.
examples: The noise from the street annoys me.

words.chinese: 恼怒的，生气的
words.definition: Feeling slightly angry or upset.
examples: He was annoyed because the bus was late.

words.chinese: 一年一度的；年度的；（植物）一年生的
words.definition: Happening once every year.
examples: We have an annual meeting in December.

words.chinese: （同类的）另一，又一；（不同类的）另外一个，其他一个；类似的（人或事物）
words.definition: Used to refer to an additional person or thing of the same type.
examples: I want another cup of tea.

words.chinese: 回答，答复；回复；接电话
words.definition: A reply to a question or problem; to reply or respond.
examples: She gave the correct answer.

words.chinese: 电话答录机
words.definition: A machine that records phone messages when you cannot answer.
examples: I left a message on the answerphone.

words.chinese: 蚂蚁
words.definition: A small insect that lives in large groups and works together.
examples: Ants are carrying food to their nest.

words.chinese: 古老的，古董的；老式的，过时的；（木器表面罩漆工艺）仿古的，古式的
words.definition: (adj.) Very old and valuable; (n.) an old, valuable object.
examples: She collects antique furniture.

words.chinese: 焦虑的，担心的；渴望的，急切的；（时间或局势）紧张的，令人焦虑的
words.definition: Worried or nervous about something.
examples: He felt anxious before the exam.

words.chinese: 任何的，任一的；一点，些许；不寻常的
words.definition: Used to refer to one or more things or people, no matter which.
examples: Do you have any questions?

words.chinese: 任何人，随便哪一个人；（用于疑问句或条件句）有人；别人
words.definition: Used to refer to any person, no matter who.
examples: Is there anybody at home?

words.chinese: （不）再，再也（不）
words.definition: No longer; not anymore.
examples: I don’t live there anymore.

words.chinese: 任何人，无论谁，任何一个人（泛指）；某个人，有人（用于疑问句、条件句等）；任何……的人（后接定语）
words.definition: Used to refer to any person, no matter who.
examples: Can anyone help me?

words.chinese: 任何事物 （用于含有否定意义的陈述句中）；某事物（用于疑问句和条件分句中）；任一事物（强调）
words.definition: Used to refer to any thing, no matter what.
examples: Is there anything I can do?

words.chinese: 不管怎样，无论如何；而且，加之；尽管，即使这样
words.definition: Used to show a change of subject or to return to a previous topic; anyway.
examples: I’m tired, but I’ll go anyway.

words.chinese: 在任何地方；无论何处；任何地方
words.definition: In or at any place.
examples: You can sit anywhere you like.

words.chinese: （空间或时间）相隔，相距；拆开，成碎片；解体，崩溃
words.definition: Separated by a distance or space.
examples: The houses are two miles apart.

words.chinese: 除了……之外（表示排除或例外）；除了……之外（还），此外
words.definition: Used to show something is separate or excepted from others.
examples: Apart from John, everyone was on time.

words.chinese: 公寓套房；（总统等要人的）房间，套间
words.definition: A set of rooms for living in, usually in a building.
examples: She lives in a small apartment in London.

words.chinese: 公寓大楼、公寓楼：一个包含多套独立住宅公寓的建筑物
words.definition: A building containing several separate apartments.
examples: They moved into a new apartment building last month.

words.chinese: 道歉
words.definition: To say sorry for something wrong or bad you did.
examples: I apologise for being late.

words.chinese: 道歉；（因不能赴会的）道歉信；辩护，辩解
words.definition: A statement saying sorry for a fault or mistake.
examples: He gave an apology for his rude behaviour.

words.chinese: （计算机）应用程序，应用软件；<美，非正式>开胃菜
words.definition: A software program for a phone or computer.
examples: I downloaded a new app for learning languages.

words.chinese: 出现，呈现；首次使用，起源；出庭
words.definition: To become visible or to seem to be.
examples: She appeared suddenly at the door.

words.chinese: 露面，演出；出庭，到场；外表，外观
words.definition: The way someone or something looks.
examples: Her appearance changed after the haircut.

words.chinese: 苹果；苹果树；苹果公司（Apple Inc.）
words.definition: A round fruit with red, green, or yellow skin.
examples: I ate an apple for breakfast.

words.chinese: 正式申请，书面申请；申请书，申请表；敷用，涂抹
words.definition: A formal request for something, like a job or place.
examples: She sent an application for the new job.

words.chinese: 申请；涂，敷；施加，实施

words.definition: Used to indicate a conditional or future-in-the-past action or polite requests.
examples: I would help you if I could.

words.chinese: <非正式>（表示极大的惊奇或钦佩）哇，呀；<非正式> 使叫绝，博得（某人的）称赞；<非正式> 极大的成功，一鸣惊人之举
words.definition: Used to express surprise, admiration, or excitement.
examples: Wow, that’s a big house!

words.chinese: 写作，编写；写道；写信
words.definition: To form letters or words on paper or a surface with a pen or pencil.
examples: She writes letters every week.

words.chinese: 写下，记下；降低，贬值（尤指减记，降低资产账面价值）；以过于浅显的方式写作，迁就读者（write down to sb）
words.definition: To quickly record information on paper.
examples: I will write down your phone number.

words.chinese: 作家
words.definition: A person who writes books, articles, or stories.
examples: He is a famous writer.

words.chinese: 写作，著书；作品，著作；写，书写
words.definition: The activity or skill of producing text with letters.
examples: Her writing is very clear.

words.chinese: 书面的，（协议、规定、法律等）成文的，（测验、工作等）书面的；书写；写作
words.definition: Produced or expressed in writing rather than spoken.
examples: Please send a written reply.

words.chinese: 错误的，不合乎事实的；（状况）有问题的，（身体）有毛病的；（决定、选择、行动等）错误的
words.definition: Not correct or true; mistaken.
examples: You gave the wrong answer.

words.chinese: 码（长度单位，等于 3 英尺或 0.91 米）；（尤指沙等建筑材料的）平方码，立方码；（某种用途的）区域，场地
words.definition: An area of land next to a house, often with grass or garden.
examples: The children play in the yard.

words.chinese: （非正式口语）是，对；表示惊讶、怀疑、不信或反对
words.definition: Used informally to mean 'yes' or to show agreement.
examples: Yeah, I agree with you.

words.chinese: 年，日历年；年，一年时间；与某事相关的一年，年度
words.definition: A period of twelve months.
examples: She is ten years old.

words.chinese: 黄的，黄色的；黄色人种的，黄皮肤的；<非正式>胆怯的
words.definition: Having the colour like that of ripe lemons or gold.
examples: The sunflowers are yellow.

words.chinese: 是，是的，对；是吗？（升调，表示疑问或请对方继续说）；是（表示肯定），肯定答复
words.definition: Used to express agreement or affirmation.
examples: Yes, I understand.

words.chinese: 在昨天；日前，不久前；昨天
words.definition: On the day before today.
examples: I saw her yesterday at the park.

words.chinese: 仍然，还；现在，此刻；迄今为止，到目前为止
words.definition: Up to now; until the present time, often in negative or questions.
examples: Have you finished your homework yet?

words.chinese: 瑜伽，瑜伽术；瑜伽派（印度哲学派别）
words.definition: A system of physical and mental exercises for health and relaxation.
examples: She goes to yoga classes twice a week.

words.chinese: 你；你们；（口语或非正式书面语）泛指任何人
words.definition: Used to refer to the person or people being spoken to.
examples: Are you coming to the party?

words.chinese: 幼小的，年轻的；存在不久的，新成立的；（显得）年轻的，（显得）岁数不大的
words.definition: Having lived or existed for only a short time; not old.
examples: My little brother is very young.

words.chinese: 你的，你们的；<口语>泛指任何人的；<口语>（用于 typical、normal 等形容词前）通常所说的，典型的
words.definition: Belonging to or associated with the person being spoken to.
examples: Is this your book?

words.chinese: 你（们）的东西；你的责任[义务]；你的家属
words.definition: Used to refer to something that belongs to the person being spoken to.
examples: This pen is yours.

words.chinese: 你自己
words.definition: Refers to the person being spoken to, used for emphasis or reflexive actions.
examples: You should take care of yourself.

words.chinese: 青少年时期；早期，初期；小伙子
words.definition: The time of life when a person is young, especially the period before adulthood.
examples: Many sports stars start training in their youth.

words.chinese: 斑马；斑马纹蝶；<南非>斑马鱼，重牙鲷
words.definition: A wild African animal with black and white stripes like a horse.
examples: We saw a zebra at the zoo.

words.chinese: 零；零点，零度
words.definition: The number 0; no quantity or amount.
examples: The temperature is zero degrees today.

words.chinese: （有某特色或作用的）地区，地带；（允许或禁止某种活动的）范围；（尤指有别于周围的）区域，部分
words.definition: An area or region with a particular feature or use.
examples: This is a no-smoking zone.

words.chinese: 动物园；<非正式>混乱喧闹的场所（或场面）
words.definition: A place where animals are kept for people to see and learn about them.
examples: We visited the zoo last weekend.
